note: R-109 review artefact read by hooks/git-workflow-guard.sh at the PR head. The range was flagged by the security-surface detector on the word rate_limits (Claude Code's quota field); the controls under review are enforce/quota-pace.sh's input validation, quota-file path checks, and its writer lock (redesigned in round 4 as a pid symlink broken only when its owner is dead). Seven rounds ran; round 7 (on 2b2bae5) found nothing above LOW, which ends the review under the 1:1 budget's security exception. Round 7's two LOWs are fixed in f2d0def. Every finding below is fixed in range with a fixture feeding the control its insecure value, or waived by the owner. The review of the head that adds this file is the PR body's Security review section. After the artefact, commit 3457407 made the fixture's timeout portable to the macOS CI runner and ad222d3 made its backdating portable too (both test-only, no change to quota-pace.sh); this artefact commit follows them so the review range ends at the head.

findings.summary: a dangling option flag made the record parser loop forever
a stale non-empty lock spun forever and two waiters could both break one lock
hand-edited usedPct or windowDays out of range still produced a ratio
an offset like +99:99 moved the reset time by days
control bytes in provider or bucket names forged text-report lines
a quota path naming a directory swallowed the snapshot
no insecure-value tests for the lock and the option parser
no insecure-value tests for file contents, environment, and offsets
the find-then-mv stale-lock break let two writers hold the lock under contention
no test raced many recorders against one stale lock
--window-days and file windowDays were unbounded
an unset HOME wrote ./~/.claude/quota.json under the cwd
a symlinked quota file was replaced by a detached regular file
report accepted unknown options
the dead-breaker path was untested and a break lock planted as a file stopped every writer
a holder stalled past the stale age could overwrite the breaker's snapshot
record overwrote a file whose buckets was 0, null, [] or empty string
a relative HOME misplaced the quota file under the cwd
the owner marker was not atomic with the mkdir lock
check-then-act between the ownership check and the write or release
the stale breaker recursively deleted any old object at the lock path
a failed marker write left an ownerless lock
snapshot source read from the file was not validated
a relative CLAUDE_QUOTA_FILE was accepted
ln -s into a directory at the break path let every waiter hold the break lock
ln -s into a directory at the lock path ran the locked region without exclusion
no test fed the lock a live pid this process cannot signal (EPERM)
a missing or limited ps read a foreign live pid as dead
clearing a dead break lock is check-then-act, so two waiters can briefly both hold it
pid liveness is judged per host and container, so a shared quota file fails a writer in another namespace
on a /proc mounted hidepid, a missing /proc/<pid> read a live foreign owner as dead
the pid-1 test never reached the EPERM branch on a root runner
a QUOTA_PROC_MOUNTS value naming no /proc proc mount read as showing every pid
ratioComplete was vacuously true for a provider with no current bucket
